title.narrative: Provision of immediate life-saving emergency food assistance through unconditional cash transfer to the floods affected households in Jowhar district

lt/pgtltp style="margin-bottom:0inmargin-bottom:.0001pttext-align: justify" class="MsoNormal"gtThe project activities include unconditional cash transfer (UCT) to 1200 floods displaced households in Jowhar district where each household will receive $80 per cycles per HH. The unconditional cash fund transfer will be in period of 3 months the project will also set up community floods risk mitigation measures to ensure the early warning system as well as improve coordination with other humanitarian actors within the target areas.lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0inmargin-bottom:.0001pttext-align: justify"gt
